_doc: Track 3 Render defaults (PLAN 4.9), look pass tuned from tests/render/polish.e2e.ts contact sheets (tests/artifacts/polish/*). Units: light intensities in candela (physical); the flashlight cookie is normalised (hot core = 1) and stops brightening closer than flashlight.nearClamp m (no blown-out hot spot up close); decay 1.6 for game-readable throw. fog: exponential height fog indoors, blended to outdoorDensity/outdoorColor while the camera stands in an open space (lot); moon = extra cold hemisphere sky light (colour + intensity) blended in while the camera stands outdoors (no DirectionalLight: its DynamicLighting arrays overflow the 12 fragment uniform buffers on Medium/Low). adapt = faint cold dark-adaptation fill light riding above the camera (visual only); core = cyan point light following the Core canister. flashlight.volLocal/volRemote weight the scattering of your own beam (subtle haze down its axis) vs teammates' beams (readable shafts). volume.density is the scattering scale of the depth-clamped ray march (maxDist m); bloom.threshold is luminance (HDR, pre-tonemap); fx.ca is ChromaticAberrationNode strength; grade.contrast is a toe-preserving power curve (never clips darks). fixture.kinds: per-kind colour / intensity multiplier / range (tube = cold green-white fluorescent, lamp = sodium lot lamp, wall = entrance wall pack, van = cargo light). Pool sizes (shadowed/unshadowed/fixtures) and shadowMap apply at page load; everything else switches live via services.render.setPreset.
